description: Professional industrial dashboard with a focus on data density, operational clarity, and high-contrast status indicators. Avoid decorative elements in favor of functional precision.

headings.instruction: Use Outfit for KPI numbers and main section headers. Keep it tight and authoritative.

body.instruction: Use IBM Plex Sans for tables, forms, and data labels to maintain high readability in dense data environments.

labels.instruction: Overlines and small headers must be uppercase with wide spacing.

background.instruction: Use stark white for cards and 10% grey (slate-50) for the main canvas to create structural contrast.

industrial_accents.instruction: Colors must only be used functionally for status (Red=Defect/Stop, Yellow=Warning/Delay, Green=Approval/Shipped).

surfaces_and_layouts.dashboard_layout: ISA-101 hierarchical layout. Sidebar navigation + Top KPI strip + Flexible CSS grid for tables/charts.

cards.instruction: Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px borders. NO glassmorphism. It reduces data clarity.

surfaces_and_layouts.spacing: Compact and dense. Use p-4 or p-6 for widget padding. Gap-4 or Gap-6 for dashboard grids.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp or max rounded-md. Primary button in structural main color (Obsidian) or context-specific status color.
components.tables: Dense. Use Shadcn Table. No alternating row colors, just clean borders (border-b). Sticky headers for long lists.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Labels above inputs. Clear validation states (Red/Green border).
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts. Keep grids minimal, tooltips clear, use industrial accent colors for data lines/bars.
components.navigation: Fixed sidebar navigation (240px wide). Clean, monochromatic icons.
components.badges: Pill-shaped, subtle background with strong text color matching the status (e.g., bg-red-100 text-red-700).

motion.hover: Subtle background shifts (e.g., hover:bg-slate-50). Do not use aggressive translations on data rows.
motion.transitions: Instant or 150ms max. Operators need speed, not cinematic delays.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark text on light backgrounds for tables.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-order-btn').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize data clarity and operational hierarchy over decorative aesthetics.
Use high-contrast colors exclusively for statuses (Success, Warning, Critical).
Do NOT center align dashboard content; left-align data for scannability.
Ensure every form and critical action has immediate feedback (Sonner toast).
Use data-testid attributes extensively on inputs, buttons, and table rows.
Implement dense layouts with clear borders to mimic industrial HMI interfaces.
